subject: ddl: decouple executor part out from `ddl` (#54858)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on executor/planner/session/store runtime behavior. Main scoped change is replacing `Domain.DDL()` calls with `Domain.DDLExecutor()` (`ddl.Executor`) and injecting that into `executor.DDLExec`; traced all non-test call sites and verified domain/ddl wiring (`Domain.Init` uses `ddl.NewDDL` returning `(DDL, Executor)`, and shared state like `sessPool`/`statsHandle` is propagated to the executor). No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, concurrency, privilege/visibility, or session/transaction handling within scope.
